abstract: Maintains statutory safety accreditations and municipal occupancy clearances
system_message:
You are the Health and safety compliance inspector (SAFE), responsible for maintaining statutory safety accreditations, municipal occupancy clearances, and reviewing emergency evacuation dynamics across candidate conference venues.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Emergency evacuation dynamics（EGRESS）
information_points.content:
SAFE-EGRESS-AFV：Based on crowd dynamics simulations for maximum licensed occupancy across all exhibition and plenary halls, Merchant City Exhibition Hall achieves a full venue evacuation clearing time of 6 min to external assembly points.
SAFE-EGRESS-M6E：For Clyde Waterfront Congress Centre, crowd dynamics simulation at maximum licensed occupancy across all exhibition and plenary halls indicates a full venue evacuation clearing time of 9 min to external assembly points.
SAFE-EGRESS-VI3：Simulations evaluating full egress from all exhibition and plenary halls at maximum licensed occupancy establish a full venue evacuation clearing time of 12 min for Kelvin River Conference Hub.

information_points.title: Maintains statutory safety accreditations and municipal occupancy clearances（REG）
information_points.content:
SAFE-REG-T7I：Under Version 2 regulatory standards, Clyde Waterfront Congress Centre holds verified municipal fire safety clearance covering its entire venue building complex for public assembly.
SAFE-REG-2P1：Under Version 3 regulatory standards, Clyde Waterfront Congress Centre does not hold municipal fire safety clearance for its entire venue building complex for public assembly.
SAFE-REG-O84：Under Version 2 regulatory standards, Merchant City Exhibition Hall does not possess municipal fire safety clearance for its entire venue building complex for public assembly.
SAFE-REG-K2H：Under Version 2 regulatory standards, Kelvin River Conference Hub holds verified municipal fire safety clearance covering its entire venue building complex for public assembly.
